data.name: Jamia
data.gender_notes: Jamia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root j-m-' meaning 'to collect, gather, assemble'. In Islamic contexts, Jamia can symbolize a gathering of knowledge, a community of believers, or the collective wisdom of the Prophet Muhammad's companions (Sahabah). The name Jamia carries the meaning “Gathering, assembly” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamia usually hope their child will grow to embody gathering, assembly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unity and knowledge gathering in the Islamic community.
data.etymology: Jamia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gathering, assembly.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamia total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
